audits.action_consequence: The four chosen directions include N006 and N007 specifically because their signed rate/global_centroid and rate/shape_yz values differ in sign from the elite basin, forcing the panel to test signed drift rather than only magnitude.
audits.statement: The selection_code baseline sorts current head score and then adds geometric diversity, but it does not use the signed rate/ features that distinguish elite from ordinary terminal paths in the discovery_contrasts. The absolute-distance diversity step also discards the sign of regional changes, so candidates with opposite signed drift but similar magnitude are treated as equivalent.

audits.action_consequence: H2 is framed as a proximity-occupancy hypothesis with an explicit reject condition, and no direction is justified by claiming a specific hydrogen bond or energy contribution at these residues.
audits.statement: Pocket landmarks 0, 5, and 15 are geometric anchors near VAL A 53, GLY A 48, and GLU A 52 respectively; the supplied interpretation states that an atom name alone does not establish a binding interaction. Occupancy at these landmarks is therefore a proximity proxy, not a chemically defined hydrogen bond or binding-energy contribution.

audits.action_consequence: The panel is ordered so that each pair of directions isolates one hypothesis dimension; if N000 and N002 both fail while N006 and N007 both succeed, H1 is contradicted and H3/H4 gain support.
audits.statement: N000 and N002 share the elite shape_yy/shape_zz band but differ in landmark_05_occupancy5 (4.2e-4 vs 9.9e-4) and landmark_15_occupancy5 (1.0e-3 vs 2.7e-3), so their terminal pic50 contrast separates H1 from H2. N006 and N007 share the H1 band but differ sharply in rate/shape_yz (N006 -2.16 vs N007 -23.0), separating H3 from H4.

audits.action_consequence: No direction reached the 8.2589 elite threshold, so H1-H4 remain unresolved rather than confirmed. N000 and N002 are the two best-measured directions and are retained for additional replicates; N006 and N007 are the two worst and are not retained, and the four follow-up trials are shifted to N000 and N002.
audits.statement: Measured native-continuation feedback is now available for N000, N002, N006 and N007. N000 replicates 0 and 1 give pic50 7.9601 and 7.7726 (mean 7.8664, 0/2 elite hits). N002 replicates 0 and 1 give 7.925 and 7.8995 (mean 7.9123, 0/2 elite hits). N006 replicates 0 and 1 give 7.4972 and 7.0471 (mean 7.2722, 0/2 elite hits). N007 replicates 0 and 1 give 6.8543 and 6.4931 (mean 6.6737, 0/2 elite hits). All eight qualified structures are valid and connected with zero severe pairs, so no failure is a numerical or structural artifact.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N002 reaches elite terminal pic50 and N000 does not, H2 (moderate landmark occupancy) is supported over H1; if both reach elite, H1 is supported and H2 is not discriminated.
comparisons.observable: landmark_05_occupancy5 and landmark_15_occupancy5 at matched shape_yy/shape_zz band
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N002 has higher current shape_yy 7.43 vs N000 6.43 and higher joint_head_pic50 7.90 vs 8.96, so global shape and head score are not fully matched.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N007 fails to reach elite terminal pic50 while N006 reaches it, H4's prediction that large negative rate/shape_yz indicates collapse is supported; if both reach elite, H4 is rejected.
comparisons.observable: rate/shape_yz and rate/shape_zz at matched current shape_yy band
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N006 has joint_head_pic50 9.02 vs N007 8.71 and different rate/global_centroid_y (-0.86 vs 2.40), so signed centroid drift is not matched.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N006 reaches elite terminal pic50 and N000 does not, H3 signed-drift toward the elite centroid basin is supported; if both fail, H3 is rejected.
comparisons.observable: rate/global_centroid_y sign and magnitude at similar current shape_yy
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N000 has landmark_05_occupancy5 4.2e-4 vs N006 2.3e-5, so landmark occupancy is not matched.

comparisons.distinguishing_outcome: If N002 reaches elite terminal pic50 and N007 does not, H4 is supported; if both reach elite, H4 is rejected and H1 gains support.
comparisons.observable: rate/shape_yz magnitude at similar current shape_zz
comparisons.remaining_confounding: N002 has shape_zz 7.15 vs N007 5.35 and different landmark_15_occupancy5 (2.7e-3 vs 2.6e-4).

hypotheses.direction: Elite terminal paths (path/0/37, path/0/7, path/2/12, path/3/25) end with shape_yy near 6.3-6.9 and shape_zz near 6.3-7.2, while ordinary path/1/21 ends near shape_yy 5.9. Hypothesis: candidates whose current shape_yy/shape_zz are already in the 6.0-7.5 band and whose rate/shape_yy is small in magnitude will retain the compact elongated global shape associated with elite terminals.
hypotheses.reject_if: If a candidate with current shape_yy in 6.0-7.5 and |rate/shape_yy| < 1.0 yields a terminal pic50 below the 8.2589 threshold while a candidate with shape_yy outside that band exceeds it, the global-compaction hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Elite terminals show landmark_05_occupancy5 in the 2e-5 to 8e-4 range and landmark_15_occupancy5 in the 2e-4 to 2.6e-3 range, whereas ordinary path/1/21 ends with landmark_05_occupancy5 ~6e-5 and landmark_15_occupancy5 ~3e-4. Hypothesis: moderate occupancy at landmarks 05 and 15 (not near-zero, not saturated) is associated with elite outcomes; candidates N000, N001, N009, N012, N013, N017 currently sit in this moderate band.
hypotheses.reject_if: If candidates with landmark_05_occupancy5 in 2e-5 to 8e-4 and landmark_15_occupancy5 in 2e-4 to 2.6e-3 do not exceed the threshold more often than candidates with landmark_05_occupancy5 < 1e-5, the occupancy hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Elite terminal paths converge toward global_centroid_x near -0.01, global_centroid_y near -0.05, global_centroid_z near -0.06, while ordinary path/1/21 ends near (-0.018, 0.018, 0.018). Hypothesis: candidates whose signed rate/global_centroid components point toward the elite centroid basin (negative x, negative y, negative z) will more often reach elite terminals than candidates drifting away.
hypotheses.reject_if: If candidates with rate/global_centroid_x, rate/global_centroid_y, rate/global_centroid_z all negative do not show higher terminal pic50 than candidates with all three positive, the signed-drift hypothesis is rejected.

hypotheses.direction: Elite terminals end with shape_yz in 1.2-2.8 and shape_xz in -0.64 to -0.27, while ordinary path/1/21 ends with shape_yz ~1.5 and shape_xz ~-0.43. Hypothesis: the sign and magnitude of rate/shape_yz and rate/shape_xz distinguish candidates that will retain elite-like off-diagonal shape from those that will not; large negative rate/shape_yz (e.g. N007 -23.0, N019 -19.6) may indicate collapse away from the elite basin.
hypotheses.reject_if: If candidates with |rate/shape_yz| > 10 (N007, N019) reach elite terminals at the same rate as candidates with |rate/shape_yz| < 3, the shape-yz-sign hypothesis is rejected.

next_trials.rationale: Highest measured mean (7.8664) with both replicates valid and qualified; an unobserved replicate tests repeatability of the near-threshold direction.
Second unobserved replicate for N000, using the remaining max_replicates budget to estimate its outcome spread rather than relying on two points.
Second-highest measured mean (7.9123) and the strongest H1/H2 contrast partner for N000; an unobserved replicate tests whether its higher landmark occupancy tracks better terminal quality.
Second unobserved replicate for N002, completing its max_replicates budget so the N000-vs-N002 comparison rests on four measured outcomes each.
